import errno,hashlib,json,os,stat,sys,time
from pathlib import Path
def checked(path,size,pin):
 info=path.lstat()
 assert stat.S_ISREG(info.st_mode) and 0<info.st_size<=size
 with path.open('rb') as stream:
  raw=stream.read(size+1)
 assert len(raw)==info.st_size and hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest()==pin
 return raw
stage=Path(sys.argv[1]); end=time.monotonic()+8
while True:
 try:
  mf=json.loads(checked(stage/'SOURCE_FILES.json',8192,sys.argv[2]))
  for name,expected in mf['files'].items():
   assert Path(name).name==name
   checked(stage/name,expected['bytes'],expected['SHA256'])
  break
 except OSError as error:
  if error.errno!=errno.ENOENT or time.monotonic()>=end: raise
  time.sleep(.25)
 assert time.monotonic()<end
os.execv(sys.executable,[sys.executable,'-I','-S','-B',str(stage/'fixture.py'),*sys.argv[3:]])
